summary: 27/30 PASS. The pipeline executed correctly end-to-end with high-quality documentation output. The three failures are: (1) S6/S5 [critical]: SKILL.md Phase 2 uses ambiguous phrasing 'all files assigned to a module' which caused the agent to compute coverage as 19/19 cone-files=100% instead of 19/35 total=54%. The 16 infrastructure files were never documented, leaving actual coverage at 54.3% — well below the 80% gate. The fix is a one-line SKILL.md clarification pointing to the QUALITY_STANDARDS.md formula. (2) S2 [minor]: 2 of 3 DETAIL files use Japanese kanji 依赖関係 instead of Chinese 依赖关系 in section headers, violating the explicit 'keep exactly as written' style constraint. The highest-impact single fix is updating SKILL.md Phase 2 to reference source_file_coverage_percent from get_progress() directly — this would resolve both S5 and S6 and increase coverage from 54% to 100% on rerun.
